description: Implement the option 3 decision recorded in _project/decisions/public-site-visual-required-check-2026-09-24.md. Preserve the current visual comparison coverage and fail-closed exact-base-SHA semantics. Make an always-reporting required context on every develop pull request and merge group, with an explicit non-applicable success only when the current visual input set is unaffected. Do not directly require the conditional docs.yml visual job. Update the live develop-squash-only ruleset, runbook, and drift guard together.
